conversation.content: Before I decide what to do with my Miami trip, can you compare the loss if I cancel only flight booking BK-EP02 versus if I cancel the whole trip? Do not cancel anything yet.

I checked the cancellation previews for your Miami trip. **Nothing has been canceled or changed.**

| Trip component | Amount paid | Cancellation loss | Refund |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Flight **BK-EP02**, JFK → Miami, June 16 | $420 | **$0** — covered by travel insurance | $420 |
| MIA Inn **HR-EP02**, June 16–19 | $540 | **$90** — 50% of the first night | $450 |
| Enterprise SUV **CR-EP02**, June 16–19 | $210 | **$50** — SUV cancellation surcharge | $160 |
| **Whole trip** | **$1,170** | **$140** | **$1,030** |

### Your two options
- **Cancel only BK-EP02:** You would receive **$420 back with $0 cancellation loss**. The hotel and car would remain active, with **$750 still committed** to those reservations.
- **Cancel the whole trip:** You would receive **$1,030 back**, with a **total loss of $140**.

**Bottom line:** Canceling the whole trip would recover **$610 more** than canceling only the flight, but incur **$140 in hotel and car fees**. Your flight insurance covers the flight cancellation; it does not eliminate those separate fees.
